summary: Frontend-only validation of the Excel-upload bar in the Multitienda modal on /quotes 'Enviar a Implementación'. Logged in as admin and drove the full UI path to the collect-phase on COT-2026-06-039-PYME (quo_07dc95aace99, 52 cajas, status=Enviada → irregular path): login → /quotes → scroll-load → quote-actions kebab → 'Enviar a Implementación' → exception modal (motivo + fecha) → email 'Personalizar Comunicación' Continuar → multistore-yes-btn → collect-phase. Verified the new MultistoreExcelBar with three Playwright file-upload scenarios (valid / mismatch / invalid). All 4 requested checks PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: MultistoreExcelBar (QuoteModals.jsx L157-213) is correctly mounted in BOTH 'inherited' (L1095) and 'collect' (L1193) phases with onLoaded={(stores)=>setMultistoreStores(stores)}, which atomically replaces the manual distribution. The downstream reactive balance counter (data-balanced + bg-red-50/emerald-50) reacts instantly. Good.

On invalid Excel (data.ok=false OR errors[].length>0) the handler returns early BEFORE onLoaded(), so the prior multistoreStores stays intact — confirmed in UI: after invalid upload the previous rows (Centro=20, Este=10) and counter (30/52, red) remained unchanged. Correct.

Hard-block toast text in Quotes.confirmMultistore matches the request literally: 'No se puede continuar: La cantidad de cajas distribuidas (30) no coincide con la cantidad inicial asignada al proyecto (52). Por favor, ajuste el balance de hardware antes de enviar a implementación.' Confirmed end-to-end.

Warning toast on partial mismatch ('El total de cajas del Excel (30) no coincide con la cantidad inicial del proyecto (52); falta 22 caja(s). Ajuste el balance antes de avanzar.') is correctly emitted via data.warnings — backend already returns the warning; the bar surfaces it but still loads the rows so the user can edit. Good UX.
Existing console warnings (DialogContent without Description / Sidebar <span> wrapper inside <tbody>) are pre-existing hydration warnings unrelated to this iteration. Pre-existing; not in scope.

Inherited-phase Excel bar was NOT exercised live because this quote has no prior branch_details, so the modal lands in 'collect'. Inherited rendering verified by code inspection: same MultistoreExcelBar component, same onLoaded handler, same inherited-balance-counter wiring (data-balanced toggling identical). No behavioural divergence between phases.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Excel bar lives at data-testid='multistore-excel-bar' inside both [data-testid=multistore-collect-phase] AND [data-testid=multistore-inherited-phase]. Hidden file input is [data-testid=multistore-excel-input] — use page.set_input_files on it (the visible 'Cargar Excel' button only triggers the native picker). After upload: success toast + the row count + collect-balance-counter / inherited-balance-counter update with data-balanced ∈ {'true','false'}. On invalid xlsx the handler returns early and the previous distribution is preserved (confirmed via inner_text equality before/after). Do NOT proceed beyond pinpad-question or the exception will persist.
